import socket,sys,time,json
import arena
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x): s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
while f.readline().strip()!='uciok': pass
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
while f.readline().strip()!='readyok': pass
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
seconds=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60
send('go movetime '+str(int(seconds*1000)))
last=''
for line in f:
 if line.startswith('info depth'): last=line.strip()
 if line.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(last); print(line.strip());break
send('quit')
PY
